'''Paul Merrian Endor Scouts''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Paul Merrian]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11441">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11441 Endor Scouts], DeckTech (Paul "Ultima 1" Merrian, 30 October 2000). == Original post ==

'''Endor Scouts'''
* '''Author:''' Paul "Ultima 1" Merrian
* '''Published:''' October 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 2.5
* '''Description:''' This deck is a simple Endor combat deck using scouts.	There is also a little space to guard the Talas for Close Air Support.

=== Strategy ===

This is an Endor scout combat and drain deck. It can fight against several types of decks effectively.

Ground Big Blue Use Lucky Shot or place Dense Forest well to isolate or destroy enemy walkers, then spread out and drain.

BHBM Keep Luke away from Vader while attacking enemy troops.

==== Space ====

Use Home One and R.S. 4 to guard the Talas while draining. If opponent has overwhelming forces, Hyper Escape

==== Combat ====

Beat them at their own game with multiple weapons.
